title: DAL verifySession() + integrasi Appwrite auth
description: Implementasi auth-proxy §4.2 lapis render. verifySession() via Appwrite account.get() dibungkus React cache(). Gate render server-side (dipanggil di layout/page terproteksi). Tanpa self-registration (akun dibuat admin/HR). Lapisan defense-in-depth ke-2 setelah proxy.ts.
acceptance_criteria: verifySession() mengembalikan user tervalidasi & di-cache per-request; halaman terproteksi redirect ke /login bila sesi invalid
close_reason: DAL verifySession: React cache() + account.get(), gate render

title: RBAC: permissions.ts can() + komponen <Can>
description: Implementasi rbac §9. Sumber peran = Appwrite Labels via getRoles(). Satu fungsi can(roles, action, entity) server-side. Komponen <Can action entity> yang UNMOUNT (return null) saat ditolak - BUKAN disable/CSS-hide. TIDAK PERNAH hardcode role==='admin'. UI unmount = kenyamanan, bukan batas keamanan (enforcement tetap server-side).
acceptance_criteria: can() memutuskan izin dari roles; <Can> unmount saat ditolak; tak ada hardcode 'admin'

title: Visual foundation: token tema + tipografi + gate aksesibilitas
description: Implementasi visual-foundation §1-§3. globals.css @theme CSS-first dengan 22 token OKLCH (baseline, boleh fine-tune ASAL lolos gate kontras §2). Inter self-hosted next/font berat 400/500/600 saja. tabular-nums kolom angka. Light-only, .dark{} scaffold kosong. Semua warna = token, DILARANG hex/oklch literal di komponen.
acceptance_criteria: Token OKLCH terpasang di globals.css; teks utama >=7:1, muted >=4.5:1; body >=15-16px; touch >=44px; ikon >=20px; tak ada warna-saja untuk status
close_reason: globals.css token OKLCH + Inter font + placeholder page

title: proxy.ts: gate data + mint & forward JWT (ADR 0001)
description: Implementasi auth-proxy §4.1. proxy.ts Node runtime, export default function proxy(). Rewrite /api/proxy/* ke Spring Boot http://192.168.1.211:8080 + attach Bearer server-side. Dua cookie: sesi Appwrite terenkripsi (JWE, sumber kebenaran) + token (JWT cached, httpOnly). Hot path decode exp zero-network; cold path mint via POST /v1/account/jwt; dedup Map ~5s. 4 HARDENING WAJIB: pin Node runtime; try/catch fail-safe redirect /login (JANGAN throw 500); hapus cookie token saat logout; refresh buffer 30s + mint duration:3600. Ini single point of failure semua trafik API - review & test paling ketat.
acceptance_criteria: Semua /api/proxy/* ter-forward dengan Bearer; hot path tanpa network; error apapun -> redirect /login bukan 500; cookie token terhapus saat logout
close_reason: proxy.ts: gate data + mint/forward JWT, 4 hardening, hot/cold path

title: Scaffold proyek + tooling dasar
description: Inisialisasi proyek Kepegawaian FE. Baca docs/design/coding-rules.md + architecture.md (§0 stack). Setup: Next.js 16.2.10 (App Router, proxy.ts Node runtime), React 19.2.4 (React Compiler on), Tailwind v4 (@theme CSS-first), shadcn init -b base (Base UI, BUKAN Radix), TanStack Query v5, Bun sebagai package manager, BiomeJS 2.2.0 dengan formatter.lineWidth=120. Struktur folder: src/hooks/ untuk logic terpisah dari komponen (coding-rules §1). Baca node_modules/next/dist/docs/ sebelum menulis kode Next.
acceptance_criteria: bun dev jalan; biome check lolos dengan lineWidth 120; shadcn terpasang di atas Base UI; folder src/hooks/ ada
close_reason: Wave 0 scaffold selesai: Next.js 16.2.10 + React 19.2.4 + Tailwind v4 + BiomeJS 2.2.0 (lineWidth 120) + shadcn Base UI + TanStack Query v5 + src/hooks/. bun dev, biome check, bun build semua lolos.

title: Halaman /login (brand + animasi air CSS)
description: Implementasi login-and-profile §14. Form login (Appwrite session), brand Perumdam Tirta Satria, animasi air CSS ringan. Setelah login redirect ke next param. Error kredensial inline. Tanpa self-registration. Aksesibilitas lansia: input besar, kontras tinggi.
acceptance_criteria: Login berhasil membuat sesi & redirect ke ?next; error inline; sesuai gate aksesibilitas

title: Halaman /profil (info akun + ganti password)
description: Implementasi login-and-profile §15. Tampilkan info akun (dari verifySession) + form ganti password (RHF+Zod via CrudForm). Toast hasil mutation.
acceptance_criteria: Profil menampilkan akun; ganti password tervalidasi & beri toast hasil

title: App shell: sidebar-09 + top bar + landing
description: Implementasi app-shell §6/§12/§13. Sidebar-09 dua-tier (nav Master), top bar + breadcrumb, halaman landing/dashboard TANPA statistik karangan (NO AI SLOP). Item nav difilter via <Can>. Base UI.
acceptance_criteria: Shell render nav+topbar+landing; nav terfilter RBAC; tanpa widget/statistik karangan

title: Primitive <ConfirmDeleteDialog> + kontrak 409
description: Implementasi list-and-tables §8. Dialog konfirmasi hapus. TANPA optimistic removal - baris hilang hanya setelah 200. 409 conflict ditampilkan INLINE di dialog (mis. 'masih dipakai entitas X'), bukan toast/redirect. Sukses -> toast (§16).
acceptance_criteria: Hapus butuh konfirmasi; baris hilang hanya setelah 200; 409 tampil inline di dialog

title: Notifikasi: satu <Toaster> sonner (mutation-only)
description: Implementasi notifications §16. Satu global <Toaster> sonner di root layout, bottom-right. Toast HANYA hasil mutation: sukses hijau auto-dismiss ~3s; gagal merah manual-dismiss (pakai reason backend). Muat-data gagal = panel inline, BUKAN toast.
acceptance_criteria: Toaster tunggal bottom-right; toast hanya untuk mutation; muat-data gagal tetap inline

title: Primitive <CrudForm> (RHF v7 + Zod) — ADR 0002
description: Implementasi forms §10. Satu <CrudForm> generik: suplai skema Zod + daftar field via shadcn <Field/>. RHF v7 + zodResolver. Skema selaras required/minLength/minimum OpenAPI backend. Error validasi INLINE (JANGAN toast). Single-column label-on-top, input >=44px. Dialog untuk form ringan, Sheet untuk berat. Logika form di src/hooks/ (mis. useCrudForm).
acceptance_criteria: CrudForm render dari skema Zod + field list; validasi inline; dipakai create & edit; input >=44px

title: API client bertipe + hook useResource
description: Implementasi data-fetching §5 + architecture §18. Helper API client bertipe untuk /api/proxy/master/{entity} (GET paginated, GET /list, GET/{id}, POST, PUT, DELETE /{id}). Hook useResource (TanStack Query v5): useQuery tabel (queryKey bawa searchParams), useMutation + invalidateQueries. Logika DI src/hooks/ (coding-rules §1), bukan inline komponen. Memory guardrails: gcTime 5min, staleTime ~30s tabel/~5min list; DILARANG gcTime:Infinity & array baris besar di state.
acceptance_criteria: useResource menyediakan list/detail/create/update/delete bertipe; queryKey bawa searchParams; guardrails memory terpasang

title: Primitive <DataTable> + toolbar + pagination + table states
description: Implementasi list-and-tables §7. <DataTable> compose sticky header, toolbar (search/filter), pagination server-side (page/size/sort dari URL - URL sumber kebenaran, bukan state). Table states: loading skeleton, empty, error inline 'Coba lagi' (BUKAN toast). Base UI, verifikasi prop ke docs Base UI.
acceptance_criteria: DataTable render data server-paginated; state loading/empty/error tertangani; sort/filter/page tersinkron ke URL

acceptance_criteria: Halaman daftar (paginated+filter+sort via URL), create/edit via CrudForm inline-validasi, delete konfirmasi (409 inline), aksi terfilter <Can> + heavy-form, 3 dropdown FK dari /list
